name: Visa2AU
description: Registered Australian migration agents (MARN 0534230, 2418663). Answers questions about Australian visa subclasses, government charges, processing times and professional fees, and can point to the relevant guide page.

skills.name: Australian visa guides
skills.description: Retrieve structured guides for Australian visa subclasses including partner, skilled, employer-sponsored, student, visitor, parent and protection visas.
examples: What are the requirements for a partner visa 820/801?
How much is the government charge for a 482 visa?

skills.name: Fees and processing times
skills.description: Government charges, professional fees and typical processing times per visa subclass.
examples: How long does a parent visa take?
